## Findings refused

- Unit 17 (`i` "they made Ödchigin kneel" against Ming 跪了 有, no 敎): refused. The note already states the discrepancy and the causative -ge- is read from sögödgemüi / sögödgeġüldebe (units 25, 31), which Ödčigin himself describes as "made me kneel".
- Units 19 and 27 (accusative -i on Qaγan as subject of a "not yet" clause): refused. Uncertain, but the notes say so and the morph gloss is honest; no firmer reading from the grammar.
- Unit 38 (oisuladqun / -dqun "plural participle" against the polite -dqun of unit 75): refused. The Ming differs (的 vs 您) and unit 38's gloss is already marked uncertain; the glossary's quγuludqun/soridqun entries treat the imperative only.
- Unit 57 and 75 (-d- + -kün against -dqun as one morph): refused as a merge. Unit 75 follows the glossary's quγuludqun "-(u)dqun"; unit 57 now follows soridqun. Glosser to keep the entries consistent.
- Unit 12 (i "that is right" / tone of žöb bi): refused; plain sense, tone left open in the note.
- Unit 16 (šögöd as imperative against 跪 in unit 17 as past): refused; each gloss differs and the notes give the reading.
- Unit 30 ("Only the other day" for kü): refused; kü is emphatic, "only" is within reach and the "ganged up … and beat him" matches 242–244.
- Unit 71 (bracketed "[žaila]" in `i`): refused; an unknown word left visible with the note.
- Unit 3 / Soqor "blind" in the glossary against the name: refused here; for the glosser to broaden (soqor, buruγu, dair: the Dair entry is a horse's name, this use is "great", so the entry needs "· also").
- Lemma spellings against the glossary (Čiṅgis, qaγan, turγaγ, doloγ̇an, buruγu, žirγoγ̇an, qorčin, boro, bökö, eteġed, tergen, qanču): all agree; no change.
